long_biography.plain_text:
Born and raised in Denmark, Martin G. Pedersen started his first business at sixteen before establishing a long commercial career in the United Arab Emirates. He is now chairman of the International Free Zone Authority, a Dubai platform focused on company formation, business licensing and entrepreneur services.

Pedersen helped develop IFZA after its 2017 launch and has promoted its expansion through partnerships with government bodies and business networks. He signed cooperation agreements connecting the organisation with Dubai Silicon Oasis and the Maldives, while advocating free zones as tools for investment and enterprise growth. His role is clearly entrepreneurial and strategic, but his equity stake, other holdings and the precise mechanism of his personal wealth remain undisclosed.
